cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Let Me Lean
cards.instruction: Get someone to carry part of the emotional burden without making you name how heavy it has become.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Could you cancel our anniversary table? The number's on the fridge. Please make the call for me.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Of course. I'll tell them something's come up and ask to move it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Cancel, not move. Don't leave them expecting another date. Give my name and tonight's time; they don't need the reason.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Would speakerphone help? You could tell me if I miss anything.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: No speaker, please. If you need to ask me something, cover the mouthpiece. Stay beside me, though.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 delegates an anniversary cancellation without naming the emotional cause. B2 offers postponement, giving A3 a real correction to make; A5 manages B's proposed supervision while quietly keeping support close.

responseLogic.evidence: A3 corrects B2's specific move-the-booking offer. B4 proposes speakerphone for accuracy, and A5 substitutes private questions while asking B to remain beside A.

relationship.evidence: B2 offers a familiar face-saving cancellation explanation and B4 wants to get the details right. A's refusal of speakerphone answers that helpful aim without manufacturing hostility.

heightening.evidence: A5 uses B4's plan to let A supervise audibly to reveal a narrower need: B handles the call, yet stays close. The dependence becomes more visible without an invented new obstacle.

specificity.evidence: A1 establishes an anniversary table and available number; A3 gives tonight's time and name as details to supply. B4's phone arrangement is understandable from dialogue alone.

brevityWit.evidence: A3's short correction serves B's impending call. A5's mouthpiece instruction and request for proximity expose the tension without explaining the emotional event.
